# Website project instructions

- This repository contains Victor Odukoya's public developer website and Pair Journey product pages.
- The site is an Astro static site. Use Node.js 24 and publish the `dist/` output through the Cloudflare Pages project `victorodukoya-website`.
- The Cloudflare production branch is `codex/website-production`; do not change hosting settings while publishing content.
- Build and release checks are `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, and `npm run check:site`.
- Keep route links, sitemap entries, canonical URLs, and generated metadata aligned with current pages.
- Store availability and product behavior are pre-release details; update them only from confirmed app and store state.
- Do not put secrets, private account data, or unapproved personal contact details in this public repository.
